notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it, and to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Symmetry Matrix.
Resolve the Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Tentacle you control.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
